production-pwa-boundaries.json.scope: Owned loopback static production build with fictional API/fetch responses. Real worker/CacheStorage/offline routing and IndexedDB multi-tab/expiry/lost-reply/capacity/clear. Fresh isolated browser context closed, static server stopped, no real providers/production/application writes. Does not certify installed-device UI, multi-build update rollout, actual push permission/delivery or hosted cache headers.

production-pwa-update.json.scope: Owned loopback production build. Offline HTML bytes vary by an inert revision comment, and the production worker's exact precache entry receives the matching SHA-256 revision. Real waiting/activation/cache cleanup and actual production dirty-navigation UI used in two tabs. Isolated context closed and static server stopped. Does not certify real device install/push, hosted retention of old hashed JS assets or changed-deployment rollback.

production-security-headers.json.scope: Isolated HTTPS loopback production build with the exact common CSP/security header values from vercel.json, including upgrade-insecure-requests. Ephemeral one-day self-signed loopback certificate is trusted only by this isolated context and removed afterward. Actual hosted TLS/certificate/header precedence, third-party frames, authenticated editors, WebGL, service workers and deployed caching remain separate acceptance. Anonymous allowlisted reads plus browser CSP reports terminated without inspecting/storing their bodies in this owned server; reports never reach the application API. All external requests and other non-read methods are refused. No credentials/application writes/provider sends.
